title: AAPS treatements has a strange date in the future
symptom: AAPS treatments show a sensor insertion entry with a date in the future (year 2106) that cannot be deleted and appears to be sent to Nightscout, causing SAGE data not to display correctly. The entry appears even when sensor change is initiated from BYODA.
fix: Users resolved the issue by deleting the future treatment entry in AAPS and/or deleting future treatments in Nightscout Admin tools. One user noted that after deleting future treatments in Nightscout, the issue did not come back.
evidence_quote: Had the same in the past, deleted this entry in AAPS and it comes back, again deleted and also deleted all future treatments in NightScout. This issue didn't come back since that.
